actions.title: Stop preloading Edge at sign-in
actions.description: Disable Edge startup boost.
actions.impact: Edge may take longer to open. Browser updates remain enabled.

actions.title: Close Edge background activity
actions.description: Disable background mode after the last Edge window closes.
actions.impact: Background browser apps stop running after Edge closes. WebView2 is not removed.

actions.title: Stop sharing update downloads
actions.description: Configure HTTP-only delivery without peer sharing.
actions.impact: Updates download from servers rather than other PCs. Windows Update stays enabled.

actions.title: Disable Windows game recording
actions.description: Configure the policy that disables Windows game recording and broadcasting.
actions.impact: Windows gameplay capture will be unavailable. This does not uninstall Xbox, Gaming Services or Game Pass.

actions.title: Turn off transparency
actions.description: Use opaque Windows surfaces for the current user.
actions.impact: Changes the desktop appearance. Font smoothing stays enabled.

actions.title: Turn off the advertising ID
actions.description: Disable advertising-ID use for the current user.
actions.impact: This is a privacy preference, not a guaranteed performance improvement.

actions.title: Disable printing
actions.description: Stop the Print Spooler and disable automatic startup.
actions.impact: Printing, including Microsoft Print to PDF and printer-dependent apps, can stop working.

actions.title: Disable fax
actions.description: Stop and disable the optional Fax service when installed.
actions.impact: Sending and receiving faxes will be unavailable.

actions.title: Disable Windows widgets
actions.description: Disable the widgets experience, including taskbar content.
actions.impact: Widgets and their content will be unavailable. Windows Search and the taskbar stay installed.

actions.title: Disable consumer promotions
actions.description: Configure the policy for Microsoft consumer experiences on supported editions.
actions.impact: Consumer suggestions and some promoted app experiences are restricted. This does not remove installed apps.

actions.title: Limit Windows diagnostic data
actions.description: Configure the required diagnostic-data level instead of optional diagnostic data.
actions.impact: Required diagnostic data is still allowed by this policy. This does not stop every Microsoft connection or guarantee a performance gain.

actions.title: Disable diagnostic tracking service
actions.description: Stop Connected User Experiences and Telemetry and disable its startup.
actions.impact: Connected diagnostic experiences may stop working. This action is blocked when Defender for Endpoint is active or onboarded.

actions.title: Disable CEIP Consolidator
actions.description: Disable this specific Customer Experience Improvement Program task only when installed.
actions.impact: This scheduled diagnostic collection will no longer run. A running instance is stopped. Update, compatibility-appraiser and security tasks are not targeted.

actions.title: Disable CEIP UsbCeip
actions.description: Disable this specific Customer Experience Improvement Program task only when installed.
actions.impact: This scheduled diagnostic collection will no longer run. A running instance is stopped. Update, compatibility-appraiser and security tasks are not targeted.

actions.title: Use the installed High performance plan
actions.description: Select the existing High performance power scheme only while Windows reports external power. Do not create or modify a scheme.
actions.impact: Can increase heat, fan noise and energy consumption. It changes the active scheme, not the separate Settings power-mode overlay. If a laptop is unplugged later, the selected plan may still apply its existing battery settings. No background agent restores the old plan. Unsupported machines are skipped; performance gains require measurement.

actions.title: Disable Edge browsing-data personalization
actions.description: Configure this documented Edge policy, with browser installation and minimum-version checks.
actions.impact: Restricts browsing-data use for personalization on eligible profiles. Enterprise and child accounts have different applicability. This does not block all browser telemetry. Policy applicability varies by profile; configuration must be checked in Edge.

actions.title: Enable Edge sleeping tabs
actions.description: Configure this documented Edge policy, with browser installation and minimum-version checks.
actions.impact: Idle tabs can suspend; active media and other heuristic exceptions can remain awake. The feature is usually already enabled by default. No extra gain is claimed when the effective setting was already enabled. Policy applicability varies by profile; configuration must be checked in Edge.

actions.title: Set Edge sleeping-tab timeout to 30 minutes
actions.description: Configure this documented Edge policy, with browser installation and minimum-version checks.
actions.impact: Only has an effect when sleeping tabs are enabled. Suspended pages may need time to resume. Microsoft-account profiles can ignore this policy. Policy applicability varies by profile; configuration must be checked in Edge.

actions.title: Disable online address-bar suggestions in Edge
actions.description: Configure this documented Edge policy, with browser installation and minimum-version checks.
actions.impact: Online search suggestions stop. Local history and favorites remain available. This is mainly a network/privacy preference, not a measured game optimization. Policy applicability varies by profile; configuration must be checked in Edge.

actions.title: Disable Edge feedback prompts and submissions
actions.description: Configure this documented Edge policy, with browser installation and minimum-version checks.
actions.impact: The browser feedback feature becomes unavailable. Security updates and SmartScreen are not disabled. Policy applicability varies by profile; configuration must be checked in Edge.

actions.title: Hide Edge first-run onboarding
actions.description: Configure this documented Edge policy, with browser installation and minimum-version checks.
actions.impact: Changes the initial browser setup experience; existing browser sessions may see no difference. It does not remove browser data or guarantee a reduction in background activity. Policy applicability varies by profile; configuration must be checked in Edge.

actions.title: Disable Edge network prefetch and prediction
actions.description: Configure this documented Edge policy, with browser installation and minimum-version checks.
actions.impact: Speculative connections and prerendering are restricted. Websites can load more slowly. This does not improve the network stack or game ping. Policy applicability varies by profile; configuration must be checked in Edge.

actions.title: Disable Edge Spotlight recommendations
actions.description: Configure this documented Edge policy, with browser installation and minimum-version checks.
actions.impact: Restricts browser recommendations and promotional experiences where this policy applies. This is interface cleanup rather than a guaranteed performance change. Policy applicability varies by profile; configuration must be checked in Edge.

actions.title: Disable Edge Workspaces
actions.description: Configure this documented Edge policy, with browser installation and minimum-version checks.
actions.impact: Shared workspaces become unavailable. Keep this feature for collaborative browsing. Ordinary browser tabs remain supported. Policy applicability varies by profile; configuration must be checked in Edge.

actions.title: Disable casting from Edge
actions.description: Configure this documented Edge policy, with browser installation and minimum-version checks.
actions.impact: Google Cast and browser casting discovery become unavailable. Browser video playback remains installed; keep this enabled if you cast media. Policy applicability varies by profile; configuration must be checked in Edge.

actions.title: Disable search highlights
actions.description: Disable the dynamic search highlights content on supported Windows releases.
actions.impact: Search home highlights are hidden. Local file search remains enabled. This does not disable the Search service.

actions.title: Disable cloud-source Windows Search
actions.description: Disable searching supported cloud sources from Windows Search.
actions.impact: OneDrive and SharePoint content may disappear from Windows Search. Local indexing is not disabled.

actions.title: Stop sending inking and typing samples
actions.description: Configure this documented policy only on supported Windows editions.
actions.impact: Stops the policy-controlled sample collection for language recognition improvement. Keyboard and local pen input stay enabled. This is a privacy change, not a verified FPS improvement.

actions.title: Disable online speech recognition
actions.description: Configure this documented policy only on supported Windows editions.
actions.impact: Cloud dictation and applications using Windows online speech services can stop working. Microphone drivers and local audio recording are not removed.

actions.title: Disable Windows feedback questions
actions.description: Configure this documented policy only on supported Windows editions.
actions.impact: Feedback solicitation notifications are suppressed. Other notifications and diagnostic services are unchanged.

actions.title: Disable cloud-optimized Windows content
actions.description: Configure this documented policy only on supported Windows editions.
actions.impact: Supported Windows experiences use fallback content instead of the cloud-optimized content. Only supported Enterprise/Education editions are targeted.

actions.title: Disable consumer account-state promotions
actions.description: Configure this documented policy only on supported Windows editions.
actions.impact: Supported Windows experiences use fallback account-state content. Account sign-in itself is not disabled.

actions.title: Disable clipboard synchronization across devices
actions.description: Configure this documented policy only on supported Windows editions.
actions.impact: Cross-device clipboard sharing becomes unavailable. Local copy/paste and local clipboard history remain separate features.

actions.title: Remove Steps Recorder
actions.description: Remove only this exact installed Feature on Demand, using the Windows servicing API.
actions.impact: Removes the legacy step-by-step screenshot recorder. Ordinary screenshot tools remain installed. This primarily removes an optional component; idle CPU/RAM savings are not guaranteed. Reinstallation may require Windows Update or matching media.

actions.title: Remove Math Recognizer
actions.description: Remove only this exact installed Feature on Demand, using the Windows servicing API.
actions.impact: Handwritten mathematical input recognition becomes unavailable. Ordinary keyboard input remains installed. This primarily removes an optional component; idle CPU/RAM savings are not guaranteed. Reinstallation may require Windows Update or matching media.

actions.title: Remove Windows Fax and Scan
actions.description: Remove only this exact installed Feature on Demand, using the Windows servicing API.
actions.impact: The legacy fax/scanner application becomes unavailable. Keep it for document scanning workflows. This primarily removes an optional component; idle CPU/RAM savings are not guaranteed. Reinstallation may require Windows Update or matching media.

actions.title: Remove legacy Quick Assist capability
actions.description: Remove only this exact installed Feature on Demand, using the Windows servicing API.
actions.impact: Only the legacy capability is removed. Newer Store-packaged Quick Assist uses a separate action. This primarily removes an optional component; idle CPU/RAM savings are not guaranteed. Reinstallation may require Windows Update or matching media.

actions.title: Remove Print Management Console
actions.description: Remove only this exact installed Feature on Demand, using the Windows servicing API.
actions.impact: Advanced printer and print-server management becomes unavailable. This is distinct from the Print Spooler service. This primarily removes an optional component; idle CPU/RAM savings are not guaranteed. Reinstallation may require Windows Update or matching media.

actions.title: Remove IIS web server
actions.description: Disable this exact installed optional feature and request payload removal without automatic reboot.
actions.impact: Local IIS sites and server-hosted development apps become unavailable. Running IIS services block this action. Many machines already have this disabled or absent; disk cleanup is not proof of faster games.

actions.title: Remove SMB 1.0 components
actions.description: Disable this exact installed optional feature and request payload removal without automatic reboot.
actions.impact: Legacy NAS devices, older LAN games or file-sharing systems requiring SMB1 may stop connecting. Modern SMB is not removed. Many machines already have this disabled or absent; disk cleanup is not proof of faster games.

actions.title: Remove Telnet client
actions.description: Disable this exact installed optional feature and request payload removal without automatic reboot.
actions.impact: Legacy Telnet command-line sessions become unavailable. SSH and networking drivers are not targeted. Many machines already have this disabled or absent; disk cleanup is not proof of faster games.

actions.title: Remove TFTP client
actions.description: Disable this exact installed optional feature and request payload removal without automatic reboot.
actions.impact: Legacy TFTP device/file-transfer workflows become unavailable. Normal downloads remain available. Many machines already have this disabled or absent; disk cleanup is not proof of faster games.

actions.title: Remove Simple TCP/IP services
actions.description: Disable this exact installed optional feature and request payload removal without automatic reboot.
actions.impact: Legacy TCP test services become unavailable. This does not remove the TCP/IP networking stack. Many machines already have this disabled or absent; disk cleanup is not proof of faster games.

actions.title: Remove Windows PowerShell 2.0 compatibility
actions.description: Disable this exact installed optional feature and request payload removal without automatic reboot.
actions.impact: Legacy PowerShell 2.0-dependent scripts become unavailable. Windows PowerShell 5 and PowerShell 7 are not removed. Many machines already have this disabled or absent; disk cleanup is not proof of faster games.

actions.title: Disable remote registry access
actions.description: Stop and disable this exact service only when no dependent service is running.
actions.impact: Remote registry administration becomes unavailable. Local registry editing is preserved. It may already be stopped or trigger-started, so disabling it may produce no idle-resource saving. IoT guidance is not desktop/gaming validation.

actions.title: Disable Windows location service
actions.description: Stop and disable this exact service only when no dependent service is running.
actions.impact: Location-dependent apps, automatic time-zone/location features and related experiences may stop working. It may already be stopped or trigger-started, so disabling it may produce no idle-resource saving. IoT guidance is not desktop/gaming validation.

actions.title: Disable Windows wallet service
actions.description: Stop and disable this exact service only when no dependent service is running.

actions.title: Disable payments and NFC secure-element management
actions.description: Stop and disable this exact service only when no dependent service is running.

actions.title: Disable SSDP discovery
actions.description: Stop and disable this exact service only when no dependent service is running.
actions.impact: UPnP discovery for media devices and other local devices becomes unavailable. Existing network connectivity is not intentionally disabled. It may already be stopped or trigger-started, so disabling it may produce no idle-resource saving. IoT guidance is not desktop/gaming validation.

actions.title: Disable UPnP device hosting
actions.description: Stop and disable this exact service only when no dependent service is running.
actions.impact: Applications publishing UPnP devices can stop working. Keep this for media-device and LAN workflows. It may already be stopped or trigger-started, so disabling it may produce no idle-resource saving. IoT guidance is not desktop/gaming validation.

actions.title: Disable Windows Error Reporting service
actions.description: Stop and disable this exact service only when no dependent service is running.
actions.impact: Crash reporting and related support workflows can stop working. Diagnosing application failures may be harder. It may already be stopped or trigger-started, so disabling it may produce no idle-resource saving. IoT guidance is not desktop/gaming validation.

actions.title: Remove Clock
actions.description: Remove this exact removable app for all existing users and remove provisioning for new users.
actions.impact: Alarms, timers and Windows focus-session UI may be unavailable. App-local data can be lost; Ducktimizer provides no reinstall function.

actions.title: Remove Sound Recorder

actions.impact: The bundled recorder becomes unavailable; microphone drivers and third-party audio tools remain installed. App-local data can be lost; Ducktimizer provides no reinstall function.

actions.title: Remove Camera
actions.description: Remove this exact removable app for all existing users and remove provisioning for new users.
actions.impact: The bundled camera app becomes unavailable; camera drivers and third-party capture programs remain installed. App-local data can be lost; Ducktimizer provides no reinstall function.

actions.title: Remove Photos
actions.description: Remove this exact removable app for all existing users and remove provisioning for new users.
actions.impact: The bundled photo viewer/editor becomes unavailable; file associations may need a replacement. App-local data can be lost; Ducktimizer provides no reinstall function.

actions.title: Remove Sticky Notes
actions.description: Remove this exact removable app for all existing users and remove provisioning for new users.
actions.impact: Notes stored only in app-local data may be lost. Export or sync notes before removing it. App-local data can be lost; Ducktimizer provides no reinstall function.

actions.title: Remove Paint
actions.description: Remove this exact removable app for all existing users and remove provisioning for new users.
actions.impact: The bundled image editor becomes unavailable. This is primarily disk/app cleanup, not a guarantee of fewer running processes. App-local data can be lost; Ducktimizer provides no reinstall function.

actions.title: Remove Windows Terminal
actions.description: Remove this exact removable app for all existing users and remove provisioning for new users.
actions.impact: The terminal frontend becomes unavailable. PowerShell and command-line engines stay installed, but terminal-based workflows change. App-local data can be lost; Ducktimizer provides no reinstall function.

actions.title: Remove Quick Assist app
actions.description: Remove this exact removable app for all existing users and remove provisioning for new users.
actions.impact: Store-packaged remote support becomes unavailable. This is distinct from the legacy Feature on Demand. App-local data can be lost; Ducktimizer provides no reinstall function.

actions.title: Remove Microsoft Family app
actions.description: Remove this exact removable app for all existing users and remove provisioning for new users.
actions.impact: The packaged Family interface becomes unavailable. This action does not disable or bypass parental-control services. App-local data can be lost; Ducktimizer provides no reinstall function.

actions.title: Remove Dev Home
actions.description: Remove this exact removable app for all existing users and remove provisioning for new users.
actions.impact: Dev Home dashboards and developer integration become unavailable. Older installations may still contain this discontinued package. App-local data can be lost; Ducktimizer provides no reinstall function.

actions.title: Restrict Clock background activity
actions.description: Restrict only the installed package family through the per-app background policy; preserve unrelated entries.
actions.impact: Alarms and focus-session background behavior may stop. The policy is computer-wide and may not control Win32 helpers. Removed apps are skipped. Other management policy can override the setting.

actions.title: Restrict Sound Recorder background activity
actions.description: Restrict only the installed package family through the per-app background policy; preserve unrelated entries.
actions.impact: Recording may be interrupted when the app leaves the foreground. The policy is computer-wide and may not control Win32 helpers. Removed apps are skipped. Other management policy can override the setting.

actions.title: Restrict Camera background activity
actions.description: Restrict only the installed package family through the per-app background policy; preserve unrelated entries.
actions.impact: Background capture can be interrupted. The policy is computer-wide and may not control Win32 helpers. Removed apps are skipped. Other management policy can override the setting.

actions.title: Restrict Photos background activity
actions.description: Restrict only the installed package family through the per-app background policy; preserve unrelated entries.
actions.impact: Background photo import, indexing or sync can stop. The policy is computer-wide and may not control Win32 helpers. Removed apps are skipped. Other management policy can override the setting.

actions.title: Restrict Sticky Notes background activity
actions.description: Restrict only the installed package family through the per-app background policy; preserve unrelated entries.
actions.impact: Notes syncing and reminders may stop until the app is opened. The policy is computer-wide and may not control Win32 helpers. Removed apps are skipped. Other management policy can override the setting.

actions.title: Restrict Feedback Hub background activity
actions.description: Restrict only the installed package family through the per-app background policy; preserve unrelated entries.
actions.impact: Background feedback-related app work is restricted. The policy is computer-wide and may not control Win32 helpers. Removed apps are skipped. Other management policy can override the setting.

actions.title: Restrict Microsoft 365 hub background activity
actions.description: Restrict only the installed package family through the per-app background policy; preserve unrelated entries.
actions.impact: Background hub notifications and content refresh can stop. The policy is computer-wide and may not control Win32 helpers. Removed apps are skipped. Other management policy can override the setting.

actions.title: Restrict Microsoft Family app background activity
actions.description: Restrict only the installed package family through the per-app background policy; preserve unrelated entries.
actions.impact: Background app notifications may stop; parental-control enforcement services are not modified. The policy is computer-wide and may not control Win32 helpers. Removed apps are skipped. Other management policy can override the setting.

startup.description: Remove this specific automatic-start registration. The application stays installed and can be opened manually.
startup.impact: {title} will not start from this registration at sign-in. Automatic background updates, notifications or synchronization may wait until it is opened. Other startup mechanisms are not changed.
